'''''Painting of the Meatlump King''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the portrait of the leader of the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group, the [[Meatlumps]].
